rationale: Bug report with six symptoms from one example run (500, wrong 200, 401, empty userinfo, repeated session-bind warning). Named entities: Oauth2Provider backend.py:700, APIKeyAuth.authenticate api.py:154, decorators._wrap:217, NoAuth, TrocToken, examples/oauth2_3lo_server.py. Token carries user_id=35 while the example's DEMO_USERS only define ids 1 and 2, and the log shows Azure/ADFS/NoAuth/TrocToken backends loaded although the example sets AUTHENTICATION_BACKENDS to Oauth2Provider only.
